title: Meghan Markle showcases Princess Lilibet's voice in video
seoTitle: Meghan Markle features Lilibet's voice in video
subtitle: Duchess posted footage on Instagram to celebrate the launch of her holiday collection
excerpt: Meghan Markle shared a home video on Instagram featuring Lilibet's voice and childhood footage to launch a holiday collection.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Meghan Markle posted a home video on Instagram to celebrate the launch of her holiday collection for her brand As Ever. The footage features a rare moment where her five-year-old daughter, Princess Lilibet, can be heard speaking.

The home video in the kitchen

In the released clip, Meghan and Lilibet appear to be making what looks to be one of the entrepreneur's fruit spreads. While Meghan stirs a pot on the stove, Lilibet mixes the spread in a bowl next to her.

Childhood memories and business

In the caption of the post, Meghan shared that she was a bit older than Lilibet when she started her first business making homemade scrunchies at the age of eight. She also recalled selling cookies, running lemonade stands, working at a frozen yogurt shop, and holding various other jobs.

The growth of the As Ever brand

The actress reflected on the expansion of her lifestyle brand As Ever since the company launched in April 2025. She stated that she feels immense pride and gratitude seeing the brand's growth and thanked her team for helping bring the vision to life.

Past images and behind-the-scenes

The video also included the former royal as a Girl Scout alongside her mother, Doria Ragland, who served as a troop leader. Additionally, behind-the-scenes footage showed Meghan preparing products and unboxing items while Prince Harry stood behind her.

Move to the United Kingdom

Sources reported that the couple moved back to England in August to spend more time with King Charles III as he battles cancer. Meghan Markle and the author of Spare avoid showing their children's faces online and rarely make public appearances with them.

With information from Page Six.
